sourceMappingDecisions: 住まい gets its own すまい article; preserve existing 住居/じゅうきょ.
N2:865 澄む and N2:866 清む map to one 澄む/すむ article that actually recognizes 清む.
狡い/ずるい maps to usual-kana ずるい; retain the rare-kanji flag and こすい-only restriction on stinginess.
Source すれちがう maps to dictionary spelling すれ違う; include written 違 in metadata and a substantive link.
姓 is the sole existing-article reuse and gets only jlpt:2.
The blank source glosses for 清む, ずらり and ずれる stay blank; lexical anchors are editorial selections.
Eighteen prospective new articles and one bounded reuse map twenty rows; these decisions are not authored or reviewed coverage yet.
crossReferencePlan: New primary-spelling reciprocal N2 pairs: 刷/刷る, 税/税関 and 清/清書; preserve kanji metadata and add reading-row/Common-words links.
Existing 姓 already links its word at セイ and Common words; do not change the kanji card just to add a sourced word level.
Additionally link the 清む spelling to the 澄む article from 清's notes/Common words, without inventing a KANJIDIC2 す.む metadata entry or treating that alias as 澄む's primary written component.
Link the already-read plain substantive mentions of 墨 in インク/インキ, 澄む in 透き通る, 性質 in 性格/性, and 清書 in 下書き, without rewriting old lessons.
consequentialTeachingChecks: Keep ordinary secondary uses: 寸法's plan/arrangement, film 製作, sliding/scheduling スライド and person-nature 性.
Physical clarity, understanding, clear weather and clear-sounding speech need specific comparisons; no transitive quiz exclusions inferred from an old card's guards.
A ずらす time shift can be earlier or later; maintain transitive ずらす versus intransitive ずれる, and regular godan 刷る versus irregular する.
製作 and 制作 overlap, especially for films; do not turn character associations into rigid professional or historical divisions.
性質 versus 性格 is not a strict things-only/people-only split. Natural-world 自然 is not the inherent nature of a material, despite bare English nature labels.
清書 distinguishes a fair copy and making it from rough drafting, ordinary copying and publication; fair is not the fairness sense in ずるい.
Do not declare final quiz safeguards until exact authored labels are chosen; an equal title already deduplicates.
inspectionStageAdvance.limits: Author-inspection accounting, not independent review, native-speaker certification or a runtime quiz draw. Prepared captures outside the selected 104 complete bodies remain capture-only. Repository content remains unchanged.

quizGuardRationale: Author hypotheses for assessment, not reviewer findings or reproduced production quiz draws. Direct symmetric, pairwise/nontransitive safeguards; an unchanged old guard never establishes a new pair.

住まい/住居 have identical full titles and already deduplicate. The declared housing/home/address pairs use the target's actual dwelling/address senses; 住む and 家庭 additionally meet its living/life range. This does not make every hotel stay a permanent home.

すまない safeguards actual apology/excuse-me/apologetic-thanks labels, including ありがとう and 恐縮 rather than just ごめんなさい. Context-specific waiting apologies remain more specific; these are broad label precautions, not unrestricted register equivalence.

墨 safeguards each of インク and インキ separately. Their identical ink titles deduplicate each other but do not automatically protect either direct traditional-ink pair. 隅 is only a homophone and has no semantic exclusion.

澄む safeguards actual physical transparency/purity, clear resonance and serenity against 透き通る/清い/きれい/穏やか/静か. The broad clear labels of はっきり/明らか/明確/晴れる/すっきり/さわやか are conservative English precautions; clarity, intelligibility, fluency, weather and calmness remain distinguished rather than asserted equivalent.

スライド, ずらす and ずれる have directly recorded positional shifts; their mutual pairs are declared once. Each further movement pair uses an actual slide/shift/move meaning, not a complete relocation-word clique. スライド/ずらす scheduling pairs explicitly consider ordinary later-shift uses in 延期/遅れる/伸ばす and change in 変更. Earlier shifts remain possible and 延ばす is not exclusively the only spelling of the postponement sense.
ずらり safeguards actual array/row/line labels 並ぶ/並べる/列/行列. A drawn line is not included merely because its English label says line.
刷る safeguards 印刷 and broad copying labels コピー/写す where printed copying is defensible. Printing is not publishing, every act of copying, a printing typeface, or the general-purpose する verb.

ずるい safeguards actual wrongdoing/sneakiness and broad clever/deft labels 不正/こそこそ/利口/賢い/スマート. Cleverness need not be unfair and secrecy need not be wrongdoing. No けち pair is inferred from the こすい-only stinginess sense.
すれ違う safeguards passing labels 通り過ぎる/通る and its additional mismatch/at-odds range against 衝突/反対/違う. Passing need not collide and a missed connection is not necessarily deliberate opposition.

寸法 safeguards dimensions/size/extent labels 大小/幅/縦/範囲 and the ordinary plan/arrangement labels 計画/予定/スケジュール/プラン/計/案. Do not erase its second ordinary sense simply because the title leads with measurements.

製作 and 作製 have identical manufacture; production titles and already deduplicate. 製作 separately safeguards 生産/製造/作る/こしらえる/作成. 制作 declares its direct 製作/作製 pairs plus other actual making/production labels. Its broad work/creation wording gets conservative 作品/仕事/作業 precautions without claiming every creation is general employment or that the source proves a result-object sense.

性質 safeguards actual disposition/inherent-quality/characteristic senses in 性格/質/性/特徴/人物/カラー/独特, including 性's unselected ordinary nature sense. 自然 is a bare-English-nature precaution, not a natural-world/inherent-property synonym claim. Qualified inherent properties does not mean owned 財産.
清書 safeguards broad copy/write labels コピー/写す/書く. Rough draft 下書き remains a contrast, not a synonym inferred from the old card's guards. Not every neat manner or legible draft is a fair copy.
相撲 and office/authority-qualified 税関 have no new exclusions. Absence is not exhaustive semantic certification. Existing reuse and backlink-card exclusions are preserved.

The shared blind derivative omits only reviewEvidence.quizGuardRationale. Validators and CLEAN reviews are not exhaustive linguistic certification or runtime quiz proof.

adjudications.decision: Add direct すまない/どうも, 感謝, 御礼 and 礼 pairs. Complete 1610020:3 and actual gratitude titles/bodies support overlap despite construction/register differences. Preserve the distinct initial severities and confidence; no transitive inference through ありがとう or 恐縮.

Add direct 澄む/落ち着く and 澄む/安心 for selected 1373680:3 serenity and freedom from worry. Complete 1589220 and あんしん 1153890 support this. The separately retained Buddhist あんじん family 1757170 does not support the primary あんしん comparison.
Add 変える directly to スライド and ずらす. Complete 1510650:1 and actual meeting-time/schedule examples establish the broad change-label overlap, not merely shared change tags or an old 変更 guard.

Replace 性質's ambiguously scoped negation with explicit statements that 性格 is not limited to people and 性質 is not limited to things. Preserve the source-supported overlap rather than inventing a fixed partition.

Add 性質/天然 for the actual bare English nature label. Complete 1439580:1 supports natural origin/spontaneity, not unrestricted synonymy with inherent properties. The actual label, not the old 自然 pair, supports this low-cost precaution; no reproduced quiz bug is claimed.

Add 刷る/活字 for the actual bare print label. Complete 1208300:2 explicitly has print/printed matter and the actual 活字 example translates small print. Preserve verb versus result/type distinctions; an old 印刷 guard alone would not prove this pair.
Further 住まい phrasing, a 寸法 pattern and a 税関/関税 contrast are nonblocking expansions. No consequential unsupported naturalness claim was established; do not claim native-speaker certification.

correctionEvidence.modelDiversity: Shared gratitude gap: GPT F01 and Claude F3, despite different severity/confidence. GPT uniquely identified serenity and scheduling pairs. Claude uniquely identified the ambiguous partition sentence and proposed the adopted nature/print-label precautions. Findings, Optional and Limits were compared. GPT read all thirteen selected-family renderings and the supplement; Claude disclosed not reading them and read three complete comparison articles. Useful complementary sample, not a controlled benchmark or model ranking.
correctionEvidence.limits: Author reconciliation and inspection accounting; not reviewer-executed Git, production quiz draws or native-speaker certification. Original source, principal, inspection records, author hypotheses and both blind initial reports remain unchanged. Duplicates are not counted again.

finalDispositions.GPT F03: Resolved: both accept separate 変える safeguards on スライド and ずらす. The author's scheduling justification uses 1073760:4, 1006420:2 and the actual 変える meeting-time example; Claude additionally cites sliding-scale 1073760:5, which is not represented as the scheduling sense.

finalDispositions.Claude F2: Adopted and accepted by both as conservative English nature-label protection for 性質/天然, not unrestricted Japanese synonymy or a transitive inference from 自然.
